# Bodhan Flex inference loader

Source: https://huggingface.co/bodhan-ai/indic-transcribe-flex
Revision: ecba9bac9013c0340fe814b336897ee51ed80be9

The Python files other than `__init__.py` (written for Owlio) are copied without changes from this revision. Original copyright notices and code-license declarations are retained where the source files include them. The inference code is licensed under the Apache License 2.0; a copy is provided in LICENSE-APACHE-2.0.txt. The model's Indic Open Model License is provided in MODEL_LICENSE.md. The code derives in part from NVIDIA NeMo as noted in its source headers. Model weights and tokenizer assets are separate local downloads and are not included in the application package.
